verifications.check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions over 4 sets C,P,B,N; a model = set of nonempty region types
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
import itertools
ok=[]
def sat(m):
    C=lambda r:r[0];P=lambda r:r[1];B=lambda r:r[2];N=lambda r:r[3]
    if any(r[0] and not r[1] for r in m): return False
    if not any(r[1] and r[2] for r in m): return False
    if any(r[2] and not r[3] for r in m): return False
    if not any(r[0] for r in m): return False
    return True
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    m=[regs[i] for i in range(16) if mask>>i&1]
    if not sat(m): continue
    res['I']&=any(r[1] and r[3] for r in m)
    res['II']&=not any(r[0] and r[2] for r in m)
    res['III']&=all(r[3] for r in m if r[0])
follow={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':{'II','III'},'B':{'I','II'},'C':{'I'},'D':{'III'}}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]==['C']
steps: Some postcards are books and all books are novels, so some postcards are novels: I follows
Cards may or may not be books: II not certain
Cards need not be novels: III not certain

verifications.check_code:
from itertools import product
# types: (card,post,book,novel) membership booleans; enumerate universe subsets of types
types=[t for t in product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[2] or t[3])]
import itertools
def models():
    for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
        for S in itertools.combinations(types,r):
            if any(t[1] and t[2] for t in S):
                yield S
c1=lambda S:any(t[1] and t[3] for t in S)
c2=lambda S:not any(t[0] and t[2] for t in S)
c3=lambda S:all((not t[0]) or t[3] for t in S)
res=[all(c(S) for S in models()) for c in (c1,c2,c3)]
assert res==[True,False,False]
opts={'A':(0,1,1),'B':(1,1,0),'C':(1,0,0),'D':(0,0,1)}
ans=tuple(int(x) for x in res)
assert opts['C']==ans and all(opts[k]!=ans for k in 'ABD')
steps: Some postcards are books, all books novels -> some postcards are novels (I true)
II: cards could be books? Not forced either way, not definite
III: all cards novels not forced

verifications.method: Dice: common face and cyclic order
verifications.check_code:
import itertools
ring_views=[('M','N'),('K','J')]  # (top,front) with O on right; front follows top in ring order
faces=['J','K','M','N']
sols=set()
for p in itertools.permutations(faces):
    if p[0]!='M': continue
    ok=all(any(p[i]==a and p[(i+1)%4]==b for i in range(4)) for a,b in ring_views)
    if ok: sols.add(p[(p.index('J')+2)%4])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=sols.pop()
opts={'A':'N','B':'M','C':'O','D':'L'}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==ans]==['A']
steps: O is the right face in both views, so M,N,K,J are the four faces around O and L is opposite O
View 1: top M, front N; view 2: top K, front J
The ring around O in order is M,N,K,J, so opposite pairs are M-K and N-J

verifications.check_code:
def cycle_opposite(v1,v2,letters):
    # v1,v2: (a,b) pairs seen in the same cyclic order around the common face at the same position
    # cycle around common face = [a, b, a', b']; find assignment of opposites consistent with v2
    a,b=v1; c,d=v2
    others=[x for x in letters]
    sols=[]
    import itertools
    rest=[x for x in others if x not in (a,b)]
    for oa,ob in itertools.permutations(rest,2):
        cyc=[a,b,oa,ob]
        for i in range(4):
            if cyc[i]==c and cyc[(i+1)%4]==d: sols.append({a:oa,oa:a,b:ob,ob:b})
    return sols

sols=cycle_opposite(("M","N"),("K","J"),["M","N","K","J"])
assert len(sols)==1
ans=sols[0]["J"]
opts={"A":"N","B":"M","C":"O","D":"L"}
assert ans==opts["A"]
for k in "BCD": assert ans!=opts[k]
steps: O is common, on the right face in both views
Around O: M then N (fig 1), K then J (fig 2)
Cycle M, N, opp(M), opp(N) contains K,J consecutively -> K=opp(M), J=opp(N)
